title: Synthesis and Coating of Phosphorus-Based Crosslinked Hydrogels on Cotton Fabric via Admicellular Polymerization for Flame Retardancy
composition: Cotton fabric from Aditya Birla Cellulose Grasim Industries Ltd.; Table 1 calls PC pure cotton fabric. Areal density, weave, yarn count and earlier pretreatment are unreported.
TGA_specimen_preparation: Own fabric specimens 6–10 mg in alumina crucibles; air and nitrogen tested separately at 100 mL/min and 10 °C/min. Cutting or grinding, conditioning, replication and programmed scan endpoints unreported.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Characterization Techniques pp 2–3 explicitly names cotton PC and treated fabrics TC10–TC40; Tables 2/3 repeat these source labels.
LOI_method: ASTM D2863, edition unreported; measured limiting oxygen index, top ignition; oxygen-index instrument model unreported
LOI_specimen_preparation: Source fabric specimens 15 × 5 cm², top ignition; geometry notation preserved. Mounting, conditioning, replicate count and uncertainty definition unreported.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Table 4 measured initial LOI with reported plus/minus values; matching fabric TG Table 2 air and Table 3 nitrogen. Original table/method/Figure 5 pixels checked; no curve estimation.
conditions_locator: Materials and coating preparation p 2; Characterization Techniques pp 2–3; Table 1 p 3; Tables 2/3 headings and Figure 5 p 5
source_location: Complete original nine-page publisher PDF, pp 1–9; methods, Tables 1–4, Figures 1–7, conclusion and all references reviewed. Original pages 2,3,5,6,7,8 inspected as pixels for recipes, conditions, numerical tables, TG profiles and identity.
limitations: Five initial source textile states represented by ten TG conditions, not ten distinct states. Table 4 measured LOI ± values are retained with unspecified uncertainty type; neither SD nor LOI replicate count is inferred. Three repeated measurements and averaging in the source relate to stiffness/air-permeability methods, not expressly to LOI. All R600 values are explicit Tables 2/3 values; the standalone hydrogel residue 34.1% belongs to a nontextile specimen and is excluded. The TC10 nitrogen row prints two T10 values, 228 and 321 °C, across its two stage lines; canonical T10 is blank for that condition, with both raw values retained. T50 and R600 remain independently reported. DTG table temperatures are retained in native fields without assigning canonical decomposition peaks, because first-stage fabric losses are attributed mainly to moisture and unreacted monomers and peak semantics are not independently defined. No stage weight loss is converted into residue. Both Figure 5 axes read Weight loss (%) although the traces descend from about100; the axis wording is preserved and no graph coordinates are used. Canonical TG scan endpoints are blank because methods do not state them; residue assessment is explicitly 600 °C. Air is assigned from the explicit method, Table 2 and Figure 5(a); prose says the untreated fabric is destroyed in an oxygen atmosphere but does not specify a separate pure-O2 assay. This raw wording is retained, not used as another condition or zero-residue claim. Nominal 10/20/30/40% BisMEP labels, introduction mole-ratio wording, source gram amounts and Table 1 mM entries are not mutually resolved; use source-native labels and entries without calculating a corrected loading or retained add-on. For the same 5 mg AAPH, standalone hydrogel synthesis reports 18.4 × 10⁻³ mM but fabric coating reports 1.84 × 10⁻³ mM; both are retained and no exponent or unit is repaired. Drying at 60 °C overnight belongs to standalone hydrogel synthesis, while fabric coating uses70 °C with unspecified duration. TC40L is a distinct after-home-laundry state with LOI 25 ± 0.2 and no corresponding TG; it is held. Source stiffness prose says decreases although its tabulated stiffness rises; this unrelated inconsistency is not used to alter TG or LOI. Source-supplied cotton is not assumed to have an unreported bleach, scour or weave. Numeric reuse search found one common untreated LOI 18/T10 319 in DOI 10.14504/ajr.8.3.5, but its other condition values, preparation and instrument differ; no shared measurement identity is asserted from that partial coincidence. Older private Dahiya2009, washable2016 and 2022 PTAP/PVPA sources have distinct materials/treatment tuples; no source-wide family exclusion or blanket independence claim.
sample_state: PC; untreated supplied cotton fabric control
washing_state: Untreated control; no durability wash assigned
treatment_method: Supplied cotton fabric from Aditya Birla Cellulose Grasim Industries Ltd., designated PC pure cotton fabric; no treatment, post-coating rinse or durability laundry is assigned.
TG_locator: Table 2 p 5; Thermal Study p 5; Figure 5(a/b) p 5
pairing_evidence: Table 1 defines PC; Table 4 gives own measured initial LOI 18 ±0.1. Table 2 air repeats PC with explicit R600 0.2% and T10 319 °C, plus T50 343 °C.
